kpmoe01.title: The 3 a.m. Confession
kpmoe01.caption:
Aries has never once waited for daylight to say a feeling.
The Moon would like a word. Who else drafts confessions at 3 a.m.?

kpmoe02.title: The Same Café Every Saturday
kpmoe02.caption:
Missing someone can turn a favourite place into a waiting room.
Keep the comfort, change the corner, and let a new routine feel like yours.

kpmoe03.title: Gemini's Other Side
kpmoe03.caption:
Fine in five group chats, honest in one.
Gemini, the Moon sees you. Who's the friend you'd send the real text to?

kpmoe04.title: Who Takes Care of Cancer?
kpmoe04.caption:
For the friend who feeds everyone and forgets to ask for anything.
Being needed isn't the same as being held. Let someone bring you soup tonight.

kpmoe05.title: Leo Refreshes the Views
kpmoe05.caption:
Leo checked the viewer list four times in one minute.
The Moon, who runs on borrowed light, has notes. How many refreshes is too many?

kpmoe06.title: Virgo's Date Report
kpmoe06.caption:
Replaying every little mistake after a good date is so common.
Next time, write down one thing that went well. Usually, that's the thing they remember.

kpmoe07.title: Libra's Stuck Scales
kpmoe07.caption:
Libra made a pros and cons list so balanced it could not move.
The Moon moves oceans. Tag the friend still weighing it up.

kpmoe08.title: Scorpio's Midnight Scroll
kpmoe08.caption:
Checking an ex's profile at midnight keeps the wound open.
Muting isn't weak; it's care. Then text a friend for a walk.

kpmoe09.title: Eight Months of We'll See
kpmoe09.caption:
Eight months of "we'll see."
The Moon has kept one orbit for billions of years and loves it. Who needs to ask "what are we" this week?

kpmoe10.title: Capricorn Has No Time to Be Sad
kpmoe10.caption:
Too busy to be sad is still sad, just scheduled later.
Book a soft night like a meeting, then call someone who'll say always.

kpmoe11.title: Aquarius Heard That Sigh
kpmoe11.caption:
Aquarius: emotionally unavailable, on purpose.
Also Aquarius: a whole drawer labelled FEELINGS. Which sign hides the biggest drawer?

kpmoe12.title: Pisces Pours Too Much
kpmoe12.caption:
If you always pour for everyone, check your own cup too.
Give to people who give back, and save some warmth for yourself.
